title: Only about 150 of 40,000 Ashurbanipal tablets translated

tellings.quote: the 40,000 Ki form tablets at the Asher Bop Paul Library around 150 have been translated out of 40,000

plain: Of about 40,000 clay tablets in cuneiform, the wedge-shaped ancient writing, found in the library of the Assyrian king Ashurbanipal at Nineveh, only around 150 have been translated. A researcher of ancient history named Matt LaCroix gives Michels this figure without naming his source. His point is that most of what that ancient library holds has never been read.
